text: 1.Aged 18 to 30 years old; 2.A good command of English 3.Analogous to graduating from senior High school in China, with good marks 4.Additional explanation: Applicants, who do not meet the above requirements, may be considered on an individual basis. They may be admitted as non-degree seeking students for one academic year. Those who pass the examinations held one year later will be automatically accepted as regular students. Those who fail will return to their home country as graduate students after completing some courses in a program.
